headline: CHC @ ATL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHC 3.18 at ATL 3.68, with a projected total of 6.86. Batter research is strongest for Matt Olson, Drake Baldwin, Michael Harris II, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ian Happ, Moisés Ballesteros because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
